verdict.rationale: Angular documents a public command surface an agent can drive: the CLI is documented per command for creating workspaces, serving, testing, e2e, linting, updating, adding libraries, setting config, deploying and managing cache. An llms.txt index is also served for machine consumption. However, the evidence only shows short CLI command summaries, not a documented programmatic or framework API reference built for automated control. Missing for 10: a documented framework API reference or programmatic (non-CLI) automation interface, depth of the CLI docs beyond one-line summaries, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving it.
